name: PUERTO RICO

flag.title: Puerto Rico Flag
flag.note: Five stripes; white star on blue triangle

lead: Puerto Rico is a sunny island in the Caribbean. It belongs to the USA, but people speak Spanish. They dance salsa and eat rice and beans at almost every meal. Old forts guard Old San Juan.

facts.label: Capital
facts.sub: Oldest US city; Spain est. it 1521

facts.label: Money
facts.sub: Uses USD; no separate PR currency

facts.label: Land area
facts.sub: Drive end to end in about 3 hours

sections.geography: A green island in the sun
sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: The Cordillera Central mountains run east to west. El Yunque is the only tropical rainforest in the US National Forest system.
Tiny Vieques and Culebra islands lie to the east. North of the island, the Puerto Rico Trench drops 8,376 m. That is the Atlantic's deepest point.
animals: The coquí is a tree frog as small as a thumb. Its 'ko-kee' call fills the night. The rare Puerto Rican parrot lives here too.
Sea turtles nest on the beaches each summer. Mosquito Bay on Vieques glows blue at night. Manatees drift through lagoons in the west.
culture: Puerto Rican culture mixes Taíno, Spanish, and African roots. Salsa was partly born here. Bomba and plena drums tell island stories at festivals.
Mofongo is mashed fried plantain. Lechón is slow-roasted pork. Golden pastelillos appear at every party. Old San Juan's blue cobblestones were once ship ballast (heavy weights).
history: Taíno people lived here long before Columbus arrived in 1493. Spain built the forts El Morro and San Cristóbal. Enslaved Africans worked the sugar farms. Puerto Rico became a US territory in 1898.
In 1917, Puerto Ricans became US citizens. In the 1950s, many moved to New York and shared island culture. Today people debate statehood or independence.
wows: Mosquito Bay on Vieques is the world's brightest glowing bay.
Arecibo's radio telescope was 305 m wide, in a jungle sinkhole.
The coquí frog hits 90 decibels, as loud as a lawnmower.
The Puerto Rico Trench, 8,376 m deep, is the Atlantic's lowest point.
El Yunque gets 5,000 mm of rain a year.
Puerto Ricans win more MLB Gold Gloves per person than any other territory.
Puerto Rico has over 270 sunny days a year.

myths.fact: The colours are swapped. Cuba has a red triangle and blue stripes. Puerto Rico has a blue triangle and red stripes.

myths.myth: All coquí frogs sing at night
myths.fact: Only male coquís sing. They call to find a mate.
